SourceFacts.Limitation: Repeatability is not production migration or rollback certification.

Default configuration keeps SQLite selected, MariaDB ProductionReady false, and experimental Lua disabled.

DependencyMatrix.Name: ProductionTargetIdentity
DependencyMatrix.RequiredEvidence: Exact production database/server/cluster, owner, engine version, application identity, endpoint, freshness, and isolation proof.
DependencyMatrix.AbortCriteria: Any mismatch, ambiguity, stale evidence, or shared/production scope uncertainty.

DependencyMatrix.Name: ProductionApproval
DependencyMatrix.RequiredEvidence: Human approver/operator/owner, finite UTC validity, maintenance window, exact target, and separated permissions.
DependencyMatrix.Authority: Project Owner/System Administrator and operations approver
DependencyMatrix.AbortCriteria: Missing, expired, ambiguous, transferred, or target-mismatched approval.

DependencyMatrix.Name: CategoryInclusiveBackupRestore
DependencyMatrix.RequiredEvidence: Checksum, distinct restore, category/recovery/grant reconciliation, smoke test, and post-snapshot write plan.
DependencyMatrix.AbortCriteria: Checksum mismatch, same target, missing category tables, divergent revisions, or unreconciled post-snapshot writes.

DependencyMatrix.Name: SchemaMigration
DependencyMatrix.RequiredEvidence: Base Page → V1 → V2 → V3 rehearsal, ledger/foreign-key/index readback, lock/latency review, repeatability, and reviewed rollback.
DependencyMatrix.AbortCriteria: Schema mismatch, FK failure, unsupported version, lock/latency threshold, or failed readback.

DependencyMatrix.Name: BackfillReconciliation
DependencyMatrix.RequiredEvidence: Dry-run counts and privacy-safe reconciliation for empty, stale, incomplete, partial, cancelled, and resumed work.
DependencyMatrix.AbortCriteria: Unexpected count/revision/generation mismatch, visibility leak, unbounded work, or unrecoverable partial state.

DependencyMatrix.Name: MonitoringFaultReadiness
DependencyMatrix.RequiredEvidence: Alerts/runbooks for unavailable, stale/inconsistent, indeterminate, audit failure, disabled provider, and failed readiness states.
DependencyMatrix.AbortCriteria: Unowned alert, sensitive event payload, missing disable path, or untested incident response.

DependencyMatrix.Name: AdministrativeGrantPolicy
DependencyMatrix.RequiredEvidence: Production identity provenance, issuer/revoker ownership, expiry/single-use policy, audit retention, and incident response.
DependencyMatrix.AbortCriteria: Unbound actor, ambiguous scope, missing revocation owner, or audit retention gap.

DependencyMatrix.Name: ProviderActivation
DependencyMatrix.RequiredEvidence: Exact target readiness proofs, feature flags, activation change record, and explicit approval.
DependencyMatrix.AbortCriteria: Any readiness failure or missing explicit activation decision.

DependencyMatrix.Name: RollbackDisable
DependencyMatrix.RequiredEvidence: Revert-to-rejecting procedure, write journal/reconciliation, restore decision, and abort thresholds.
DependencyMatrix.Authority: Change owner and rollback decision owner
DependencyMatrix.AbortCriteria: Rollback loses untracked writes or cannot restore safe rejecting behavior.

DependencyMatrix.Name: HistoricalCompatibility
DependencyMatrix.AbortCriteria: Unresolved source provenance or unsupported behavior in required migration scope.
